findings.title: MCP TypeScript server SDK cross-client message delivery
findings.security_fact: Affected HTTP MCP servers could route one client's responses or notifications to another when a stateless transport or a McpServer/Server instance was shared; JSON-RPC request IDs collide in normal SDK client use.
findings.affected_boundary_or_version: @modelcontextprotocol/server versions >=2.0.0 and <2.3.0; multi-client HTTP endpoints that instantiate the transport or server once at startup.
findings.mitigation_or_patch: Upgrade to 2.3.0 or later and use a fresh server and transport per request, or maintain a server and transport per session.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP servers bridge AI agents to tools and data. Cross-client routing can expose tool responses or notifications across tenant and authority boundaries.

follow_up_actions: During ingest, reconcile deployed MCP HTTP servers against the affected shared-instance pattern, not package version alone.

findings.title: MCP TypeScript SDK validation memory-exhaustion denial of service
findings.security_fact: A single HTTP request within the default 4 MiB size limit could cause unbounded validation of array elements and object keys, exhausting server memory and aborting the JavaScript process.
findings.affected_boundary_or_version: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >=1.3.0 and <1.32.0; @modelcontextprotocol/server >=2.0.0 and <2.3.0; HTTP-reachable servers, especially tools that accept arrays or records.
findings.mitigation_or_patch: Upgrade to SDK 1.32.0 or server 2.3.0 or later, set maxToolInputElements, and set a transport or parser request-body limit appropriate to the tool.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: Untrusted clients can use a tool-input validation path to deny service to an agent tool boundary without credentials unless authentication occurs before the SDK.

findings.title: MCP TypeScript SDK bearer-token audience validation gap
findings.security_fact: The server-side bearer-authentication helpers accepted a token minted for another service when the same authorization server served multiple services and the application did not independently validate the token audience.
findings.mitigation_or_patch: Upgrade to the patched versions and configure expectedResource plus AuthInfo.resource, or reject tokens whose aud claim does not include the MCP server.
findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_security: MCP bearer authentication often authorizes delegated agent actions. Accepting another service's token violates least privilege and can grant an agent or caller unintended tool authority.
